a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate this round. Storm risk is high, but grabbing early would just leave one of us stranded. Let's get the reserve to 8 fast, then take 4 each. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we'll agree on it together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Next round we should reach 8, then we each take exactly 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
